column1: # PANTHER groundings known to be wrong, awaiting curation.
# Each row names ONE descriptor (module + declared family + its representative
# members). Anything not listed here still fails validation, so this register
# cannot hide a new mistake. It may only SHRINK: fix the grounding, then delete
# the row. A row that stops applying is itself a validation error.
# kind=fabricated-id            the authored label names a different protein than
#                               the id -- the id was guessed, not mistyped.
# kind=wrong-family-right-name  the id is a real family whose name fits, but
#                               PANTHER classifies this protein in another one.
# None of these descriptors carries an ancestral_node, so no IBD/evolutionary
# inference is built on the bad placement; fixing one is a grounding decision,
# not a re-derivation. Verify the intended protein before changing any id -- the
# representative member, not the label, is the reliable anchor.
